The '''''Harrower''''' was a [[ZH-25 Questor-class light freighter|ZH-25 Questor-class]] that was present in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was fitted with a dorsal turret-mounted medium [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]].<ref name="CotG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Harrower'' appeared in the roleplaying guide ''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''. According to the guide, the ship belonged either to the [[Whitescar Syndicate]] or to the bounty hunters led by [[Nex Pavros]], making its actual ownership unclear.<ref name="CotG" />
